title: One command to set up a machine: building eng.
description: How eng sets up an ideaSquared developer machine with one command, and what we learned building it.
summary: An installer that is safe to run again, a themed terminal app, and an SSH tunnel that lasted a few hours.
lede: eng takes a new laptop to a working ideaSquared setup with one command, then keeps it up to date. It also grew a themed terminal app, and a few lessons about handing a terminal back and forth.
